note: One-shots only. No stems from released songs, and no reference audio. Each file in this folder is a short mono 44.1 kHz excerpt of the named source, with a short fade so the hit does not carry the room. The license below is the license of that source. v9 uses the kick file as the beater on the mill's 44 Hz body, and uses the hat and clap files as those voices. v7d uses the closed and open hat files. The bass, plucks, and stabs stay the mill voices.

samples.licenseEvidence: The Virtuosity Drums repository LICENSE file is the CC0 1.0 legal code. This kick is a house-kit hit from that library, snares off, mid mic, velocity 2 round-robin 1.
samples.excerpt: 48 kHz stereo flac summed to mono, resampled to 44.1 kHz, 164 ms from just before the beater, then a decay after 30 ms so the room does not linger.
